answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 12 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in plume, checked in velvet, and nectar shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1835 identities would post 3352 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
